name: Thai-Style Steak Salad with Cucumber, Tomatoes & Peanuts

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
3 limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
1 ½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the mixed greens to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 6-mm-thick half-rounds at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallots; peel and halve the shallots lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Roughly chop the peanuts and transfer to a small bowl.
Juice the limes into a small bowl (that will be used to make the dressing).
To the lime juice, add olive oil, fish sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp fish sauce
3 tsp honey
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and thinly slice against the grain.
To serve, divide the salad between plates, top with the steak slices, and garnish with the chopped peanuts. Enjoy!
